aiAgent.title: Draft a plan with Helix
aiAgent.description: Ask Helix to draft a trip plan grounded in your past charging history along the corridor. The plan is never saved automatically — review the proposed plan and click Plan in the form below to save it.
aiAgent.noVehicle: Select a vehicle to let Helix draft a trip plan.
aiAgent.noOrigin: Set a starting point for Helix to plan the route from.
aiAgent.noDestination: Set a destination for Helix to plan the route to.
aiAgent.draftingDescription: Ask Helix to draft a trip plan grounded in your past charging history along the corridor. This advisory draft does not change the form, compute a route, or save a plan. Review the suggestions, enter your trip inputs in the form below, and use Plan to compute the route separately.

brief.costDescription: Estimated EV cost and gasoline equivalent from the current trip-plan comparison; original price and vehicle-economy assumptions are retained.

tripPlanner.notFeasible: This trip may not be feasible with the current battery level and available charging options. Consider starting with a higher SOC or adjusting your preferences.

insights.title: Trip Insights
insights.empty: Plan a trip to see feasibility, estimates, and weather impact.
insights.feasibleNote: Reaches the destination above your minimum arrival SOC.
insights.infeasibleNote: Start with a higher SOC or add charging headroom.
insights.weatherUnavailable: Weather impact is unavailable for this plan.

tripPlanner.disclaimer: This is an estimate based on straight-line distance (×1.3 driving factor) and your vehicle's historical efficiency. Actual results may vary due to route geometry, traffic, elevation, and conditions.

cost.title: Trip Cost vs Gas
cost.empty: Plan a trip to compare EV charging cost against gasoline.

copilot.title: Trip Copilot
copilot.empty: Enter remaining distance for a live arrival verdict.
copilot.manualScenario: Manual scenario: starting SOC {{soc}}% and minimum arrival SOC {{floor}}% come from the planner form, not live telemetry.
copilot.defaultAssumptions: Server default assumptions: 75 kWh battery capacity, 160 Wh/km consumption, and 1.0 efficiency factor.
copilot.unknownObservations: Vehicle observations are unknown for this check: live SOC, actual battery capacity, recent efficiency, and route conditions are not supplied. This is an estimate, not a live arrival guarantee.
copilot.scenarioEmpty: Enter remaining distance to estimate arrival for this manual scenario.
copilot.checkedScenario: Checked scenario: starting SOC {{soc}}%, minimum arrival SOC {{floor}}%, remaining distance {{distance}} km.
copilot.inputsChanged: Inputs have changed. This result applies only to the checked scenario; check again for the current inputs.
